changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[GetRelationshipDisplayValue] ( @o varchar(50), @oid int ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( select DisplayValue from dbo.Asset A cross apply [dbo].[GetAssetDisplayValueById](A.ID) DV where @o = 'FusionAttribute' and A.[Object] = @o and A.ObjectID = @oid union select DV.DisplayValue from dbo.Asset A inner join dbo.AssetDisplayValue DV on DV.AssetID = A.ID where @o not in('Taxonomy','FusionAttribute') and A.[Object] = @o and A.ObjectID = @oid union all select TextPath from dbo.Asset A cross apply [dbo].GetAssetTextPathById(A.ID,'/') where @o = 'Taxonomy' and A.[Object] = @o and A.ObjectID = @oid )
